newsitem.title: USA: ViroPharma says treatment curbs meningitis.
newsitem.headline: ViroPharma says treatment curbs meningitis.

text.p: ViroPharma Inc said on Wednesday that its phase II clinical trial of its Pleconaril treatment of viral meningitis showed that the treatment shortened the disease duration.
Pleconaril treatment resulted in a statistically significant shortening of disease duration to 4.0 days from 9.5 days, ViroPharma said.

Elements of the primary endpoint included clinically important symptoms of viral meningitis such as a reduction in severe incapacitating headache, which usually leads to hospitalization, the company said.
ViroPharma said it will present the results of the 39-patient study at a scientific forum in the near future.
ViroPharma said Pleconaril was well-tolerated by patients in the study.
